Refund_not_showing_up: This category concerns a refund that is not yet visible in the account. The refund status and the merchant's confirmation are relevant to a review of the transaction.
activate_my_card: This category concerns card activation. Activation methods and eligibility depend on the card and the bank's documented procedure.
age_limit: This category concerns the minimum age for opening or using an account. Age requirements depend on the account type and the applicable eligibility rules.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: This category concerns Apple Pay or Google Pay. Compatibility depends on the card, device, country and bank's supported wallet services.
atm_support: This category concerns ATM compatibility. Supported ATM networks and available services depend on the card issuer and ATM operator.
automatic_top_up: This category concerns automatic account top-ups. Availability, trigger conditions and funding methods depend on the account's supported settings.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: This category concerns a bank transfer that has not appeared in the balance. The transfer reference, processing status and expected settlement time are relevant to the review.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: This category concerns a balance that has not updated after a cheque or cash deposit. Deposit acceptance and clearing conditions depend on the bank and deposit method.
beneficiary_not_allowed: This category concerns a beneficiary that cannot receive a transfer. Beneficiary eligibility and transfer restrictions depend on the destination and account rules.
cancel_transfer: This category concerns transfer cancellation. Cancellation availability depends on the transfer's processing stage and the receiving payment network.
card_about_to_expire: This category concerns an expiring card. Replacement arrangements and validity dates depend on the issuer's renewal procedure.
card_acceptance: This category concerns card acceptance by merchants. Acceptance depends on the payment network, merchant and transaction type.
card_arrival: This category concerns a card that has not arrived. The delivery status, dispatch date and estimated arrival date are relevant to a delivery review.
card_delivery_estimate: This category concerns the expected card delivery time. Delivery estimates depend on dispatch, destination and delivery method.
card_linking: This category concerns linking a card to an account or application. Eligibility and linking steps depend on the card type and issuer's procedure.
card_not_working: This category concerns a card that does not work. Card status, activation, expiry and transaction restrictions are relevant to a diagnosis.
card_payment_fee_charged: This category concerns a fee on a card payment. The transaction details and the bank's applicable tariff determine the reason for the charge.
card_payment_not_recognised: This category concerns an unrecognised card payment. Merchant identification and transaction details are relevant to a review under the bank's dispute procedure.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: This category concerns the exchange rate applied to a card payment. The original currency, conversion date and conversion provider are relevant to the calculation.
card_swallowed: This category concerns a card retained by an ATM. Card security and recovery procedures depend on the ATM operator and issuing bank.
cash_withdrawal_charge: This category concerns a cash withdrawal fee. Charges may depend on the ATM operator, withdrawal conditions and the bank's applicable tariff.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: This category concerns an unrecognised cash withdrawal. The ATM location, timestamp and account records are relevant to the bank's investigation.
change_pin: This category concerns changing a card PIN. Available methods depend on the card issuer and supported ATM or application services.
compromised_card: This category concerns potentially compromised card details. Card protection, replacement and disputed transactions fall under the bank's security procedures.
contactless_not_working: This category concerns a contactless payment failure. Contactless settings, transaction limits and card or terminal compatibility are relevant factors.
country_support: This category concerns the countries in which an account or service is available. Coverage depends on the bank's current eligibility rules.
declined_card_payment: This category concerns a declined card payment. Available balance, card status, transaction limits and issuer restrictions are relevant to the decline.
declined_cash_withdrawal: This category concerns a declined ATM withdrawal. Available balance, withdrawal limits and ATM compatibility are relevant to the decline.
declined_transfer: This category concerns a declined transfer. Beneficiary details, account restrictions and transfer limits are relevant to the payment status.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: This category concerns an unrecognised direct debit. The creditor reference and recorded mandate are relevant to the bank's dispute procedure.
disposable_card_limits: This category concerns disposable virtual card limits. Usage restrictions depend on the issuer, merchant and type of payment.
edit_personal_details: This category concerns changes to personal account details. Supported changes and verification requirements depend on the bank's account maintenance procedure.
exchange_charge: This category concerns a currency exchange fee. Charges depend on the currencies, transaction conditions and applicable tariff.
exchange_rate: This category concerns the applicable currency exchange rate. Rates depend on the currency pair, conversion provider and time of conversion.
exchange_via_app: This category concerns currency exchange through the banking application. Supported currencies and exchange conditions depend on the account's available services.
extra_charge_on_statement: This category concerns an additional charge on an account statement. Transaction references and fee descriptions are relevant to identifying the charge.
failed_transfer: This category concerns a failed transfer. The payment status, failure reason and any returned funds are relevant to the transaction review.
fiat_currency_support: This category concerns supported fiat currencies. Available account balances, exchange services and payment currencies depend on the bank's offering.
get_disposable_virtual_card: This category concerns obtaining a disposable virtual card. Availability and activation depend on the account type and issuer's supported card services.
get_physical_card: This category concerns access to a physical card. Eligibility and available card formats depend on the account and issuer.
getting_spare_card: This category concerns obtaining an additional card. Availability, number of cards and charges depend on the account's card policy.
getting_virtual_card: This category concerns obtaining a virtual card. Availability and permitted uses depend on the account and issuer's virtual card services.
lost_or_stolen_card: This category concerns a lost or stolen card. Card blocking, replacement and transaction review follow the issuer's security procedure.
lost_or_stolen_phone: This category concerns a lost or stolen phone used for banking. Account access recovery and device security depend on the bank's authentication procedure.
order_physical_card: This category concerns placing an order for a physical card. Order options, delivery information and charges depend on the issuer's ordering procedure.
passcode_forgotten: This category concerns a forgotten application passcode. Access recovery depends on the bank's identity verification and authentication procedure.
pending_card_payment: This category concerns a pending card payment. The authorisation status and merchant settlement determine when the payment is completed or released.
pending_cash_withdrawal: This category concerns a pending cash withdrawal. ATM records and payment processing status are relevant to settlement or reversal.
pending_top_up: This category concerns a pending account top-up. Processing status depends on the funding method and participating payment providers.
pending_transfer: This category concerns a pending transfer. Settlement timing depends on the payment network, transfer details and processing checks.
pin_blocked: This category concerns a blocked card PIN. Unblocking methods depend on the card issuer and the reason for the block.
receiving_money: This category concerns receiving funds into an account. Available receiving methods and required account details depend on the account's supported services.
request_refund: This category concerns requesting a payment refund. Refund eligibility and processing depend on the merchant and applicable dispute procedure.
reverted_card_payment?: This category concerns a reversed card payment. A reversal reflects a payment authorisation or transaction that was returned or cancelled; the transaction status provides the relevant context.
supported_cards_and_currencies: This category concerns cards and currencies supported for account funding. Compatibility depends on the card issuer, funding currency and bank's top-up rules.
terminate_account: This category concerns account closure. Closure requirements depend on the account balance, pending transactions and bank's documented procedure.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: This category concerns fees for funding an account by bank transfer. Charges depend on the sending bank, payment network and receiving account conditions.
top_up_by_card_charge: This category concerns fees for funding an account by card. Charges depend on the funding card, issuer and applicable top-up tariff.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: This category concerns funding an account with cash or cheques. Availability and deposit conditions depend on the account's supported funding methods.
top_up_failed: This category concerns a failed account top-up. The funding method, provider response and transaction status are relevant to the failure.
top_up_limits: This category concerns account top-up limits. Minimum and maximum amounts depend on the funding method, account and applicable verification rules.
top_up_reverted: This category concerns a reversed account top-up. The funding transaction status and return processing determine whether funds are returned to the original source.
topping_up_by_card: This category concerns funding an account with a payment card. Supported cards and required transaction verification depend on the bank's funding services.
transaction_charged_twice: This category concerns a possible duplicate charge. Merchant references and the final status of both entries are relevant to confirming a duplicate payment.
transfer_fee_charged: This category concerns a transfer fee. Charges depend on the payment route, currencies and participating banks' tariffs.
transfer_into_account: This category concerns an incoming bank transfer. Required account identifiers and accepted transfer routes depend on the account and originating currency.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: This category concerns a transfer not received by its beneficiary. The transfer reference, beneficiary details and settlement status are relevant to tracing the payment.
transfer_timing: This category concerns transfer processing time. Timing depends on the payment network, currencies, cut-off times and processing calendar.
unable_to_verify_identity: This category concerns unsuccessful identity verification. Document quality, supported document types and recorded account details are relevant to the verification result.
verify_my_identity: This category concerns completing identity verification. Required documents and verification steps depend on the account's eligibility and compliance procedure.
verify_source_of_funds: This category concerns verification of the source of funds. Supporting documents depend on the bank's review and the origin of the funds.
verify_top_up: This category concerns verification of a card top-up. Authentication requirements depend on the funding card and the participating payment providers.
virtual_card_not_working: This category concerns a virtual card payment failure. Card status, merchant support and transaction restrictions are relevant to the failure.
visa_or_mastercard: This category concerns the card payment network. Visa or Mastercard availability depends on the issuer, region and available card products.
why_verify_identity: This category concerns the purpose of identity verification. Verification supports account identification and the bank's applicable compliance requirements.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: This category concerns an ATM dispensing an unexpected amount of cash. The requested amount, dispensed amount and ATM transaction record are relevant to a review.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: This category concerns the exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal. The withdrawal currency, conversion provider and transaction date are relevant to the calculation.
